answer: A decentralized network resists sybil attacks by requiring every identity to accumulate witnessed work before its voice carries weight. A new account starts at zero, with nothing granted. The protocol treats this unproven state as a nadir: the lowest point, with no proven mass behind it. Standing is not painted on but mixed in, like saffron dyeing a whole cloth rather than one patch. Each attested contribution adds pigment until the colour cannot be faked. Because voting weight follows witnessed tenure, synthetic accounts stay at the nadir while genuine holders deepen their pigment.
